answer: Each agent earns access by posting a bond that is slashed if independent audits uncover fabricated identities or collusion. Auditors sample claims and compare their evidence across agents; an echo of the same source or coordinated timing can trigger deeper review, while unrelated agents may wander into the sample too. A marble-sized bond would not deter anyone, so the required stake must exceed the expected gain from creating extra identities. Sybils then require real capital, and detected fraud forfeits it.
